description: Read the TronSave market summary: resource currently available and total listed for ENERGY and BANDWIDTH, number of pooled sellers, and seller APY (percent). Use for a quick 'how is the market' answer before pricing; for prices use `tronsave_get_price_table` (grid) or `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` (one quote), for depth by price use `tronsave_list_order_books`. Public, read-only. Data refreshes about every TRON block (3 s).
name: tronsave_get_market_overview

anyOf.description: Number of sellers in the pool.

totalPool.description: Number of sellers in the pool.

title: Market Overview
